mcp.listening: Listening on {url}, for this PC only.
mcp.portTaken: another program uses its port. Choose New address and key.
mcp.keyUnreadable: its key could not be saved on this PC.
mcp.what: Assistants can read your displays, views, widgets, notes, tasks, habits and calendar events. They cannot change anything, and the clipboard, mail, accounts and files stay out of reach.
mcp.connect: Claude Code: copy the command and run it in a terminal. Other assistants: copy the JSON into their MCP settings.
mcp.copied: Copied. It holds this PC's access key: paste it only into your assistant's setup.
mcp.copyFailed: Could not copy: another app is holding the clipboard.
mcp.newAddressConfirm: Make a new address and key?
mcp.newAddressDetail: Assistants set up with the old ones stop reaching Themia until you copy the setup again.
